component: Account Hub discovery endpoint and OAuth scope

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 1375 Hub starts calendar and address-book discovery at the email domain and has Google-specific scope checks. The accepted flow builds candidate hostnames, includes a different incoming hostname only when the eTLD site matches, and has a separate Graph branch. Its CardDAV path checks OAuth initialization and refresh-token availability before discovery. Prefer these accepted boundaries when extending this flow; do not copy the older Google-only string check as a complete current permission rule. No credential transmission, scope grant or redirect was exercised. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Current Hub discovery broadens the domain search under explicit site and auth checks
